title: Relics of the Eras
text: Suspicious Time Sand from different strata hides relics from different ages. The Phantom Calling Card is a charm granting one extra level each of Fortune and Looting and 10% movement speed. Its enhanced form raises both bonuses to level II and speed to 15%.

D-Class Credentials reduce incoming damage by 10%. C-Class adds 10% spell power; B-Class raises damage reduction to 20% and adds ten mana cost reduction; A-Class also sustains regeneration and periodically grants saturation. The SCP-714 ring grants Absorption II but lowers movement speed by 20%.
The Ring of Lust grants 25% melee damage and 25% lifesteal; the Ring of Greed grants 20% spell power. Desire Crystals aid related upgrades; see the assembly and reversal recipes.
